editorial:
Imagine being stuck in the middle of nowhere in Utah with three people you barely trust. You are part of a small gang of criminals just trying to get by, but you quickly realize you are being hunted. A crazy, mean bandit is trailing you across the desert, turning your trip into a deadly game of cat and mouse. The vibe is gritty and mean, making you feel the heat and the stress of the open road. It is not your typical hero story; instead, it feels like a survival fight where anyone could turn on each other at any second.

What really makes this one pop is the tension and the raw acting. While the pace slows down in some spots, the bursts of violence are sudden and shocking. If you love old-school grit and don't mind a slower burn, you will dig this. It is best to grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see all the dusty detail, but renting it on Apple TV is a great way to check it out first. Just make sure you have some snacks and a big screen to really feel the scale of the wasteland.
endingExplained: In the end, the tension peaks as the group is picked off one by one. The sadistic bandit finally catches up to the survivors in a brutal showdown. After a lot of fighting and betrayal, the villain is eventually stopped, but not before he leaves a trail of blood. It wraps up with a bleak feeling, showing that in this harsh desert, there are no real winners, only survivors who have lost everything.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark westerns and survival stories.
